description: Add 15 to current speaker volume when thermostat fan starts; subtract 15 from current volume when it stops. Manual adjustments are preserved. ADB readback required. Fan operation is inferred, not physically measured.

then.stop: TV off: cancel outstanding boost without sending volume commands

actions.value_template: {{ states(tv) in ['on', 'idle', 'playing', 'paused'] and states(flag) in ['on', 'off'] and climate_state in ['off', 'heat', 'cool', 'auto', 'fan_only'] and fan_mode in ['low', 'high', 'auto'] and hvac_action in ['off', 'idle', 'heating', 'cooling', 'fan'] }}

variables.fan_running: {{ climate_state == 'fan_only' or hvac_action in ['heating', 'cooling', 'fan'] or (climate_state != 'off' and fan_mode in ['low', 'high']) }}

actions.value_template: {{ (fan_running and is_state(flag, 'off')) or (not fan_running and is_state(flag, 'on')) }}

variables.target_volume: {{ [[(matches[0] | int) + (15 if fan_running else -15), 0] | max, 100] | min }}

if.value_template: {{ ('volume is ' ~ target_volume ~ ' in range [0..100]') not in (volume_write.get(tv, {}).get('adb_response', '') or '') }}

data.title: Casita TV volume adjustment needs checking
data.message: ADB did not confirm the requested volume. Automatic repeated adjustment was suppressed. Check the TV and the Fan Boost Active helper before the next fan transition.
